paragraphs: The X3 xDrive30e is the plug-in hybrid variant of the G01-generation X3, produced from 2020 to 2024. It pairs the B48 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine with an electric motor, offering a balance of efficiency and performance that made it a popular choice in the X3 range. The G01 xDrive30e was discontinued when BMW fully redesigned the X3 for model year 2025 with the G45 generation — but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: The X3 xDrive30e is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
